blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير والاوسط ورجالهما ثقات، مجمع الزوائد: ٨ /١٢٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the fifteenth night of the month of Sha'ban, Allah Ta'ala turns His attention towards all His creation. He forgives all His creatures. But two are not forgiven: the one who associates partners with Allah; and the one who holds enmity towards someone.” Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: تُعْرَضُ اْلاَعْمَالُ يَوْمَ اْلاِثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيْسِ، فَمِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ فَيُغْفَرُ لَهُ، وَمِنْ تَائِبٍ فَيُتَابُ عَلَيْهِ، وَيُرَدُّ اَهْلُ الضَّغَائِنِ بِضَغَائِنِهِمْ حَتَّي يَتُوْبُوْا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورواته ثقات، الترغيب: ٣ /٤٥٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Every Monday and every Thursday the deeds of the servants are presented in the court of Allah Ta'ala. Those who seek forgiveness are granted forgiveness, and those who make Taubah are granted pardon from sin. (But) those who hold enmity are left aside because of their enmity; their Istighfar (seeking forgiveness) is not accepted until they (give up the enmity and make Taubah).” Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ مُوْسَي ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: اَلْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا وَشَبَّكَ بَيْنَ اَصَابِعِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري، باب نصر المظلوم، رقم:٢٤٤٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Having said, “The friendship a Muslim has with another Muslim is like a building, one part of which strengthens another part,” the Prophet ﷺ interlaced the fingers of one hand with the fingers of the other hand and showed it. Muslims too must be joined to one another in this way, (and, one should be a support to the other
